_note: Course agent worksheet, per role (numeric goal + deadline, named tools, action order, human checkpoint, success metric, risk, guardrail). tests/test_agent_config.py checks these tools equal the ENFORCED allowlists in src/mi/agents/tools.py and that no role can approve, send, spend or publish. Roles run as deterministic nodes; live LLM execution is PENDING (no runtime key).

coordinator.goal: 1 versioned dossier per run reaching REVIEW_REQUESTED with 0 provenance violations, within the one-command pipeline (< 5 min)
coordinator.human_checkpoint: named approver approves or rejects in app tab 4 or CLI
coordinator.success_metric: dossier reaches the checkpoint with every number citing a tool call
coordinator.guardrail: fixed order; at most one research loop-back

research.goal: >= 5 span-verified source claims and all unknowns listed per run; 20 GEO answers ingested once collected
research.human_checkpoint: two reviewers judge semantic support before any slide quote
research.success_metric: answer-or-abstain accuracy on locked/adversarial sets; 0 fabricated spans accepted
research.risk: prompt injection, stale or out-of-scope sources
research.guardrail: read-only tools; source-scope rule; conflicting spans withheld

intelligence.goal: model AP gain over the recency rule with a 95% CI excluding 0 on the evaluation window, else use the rule
intelligence.human_checkpoint: analyst signs off the model card
intelligence.success_metric: pre-registered adoption rule applied; subgroup CIs reported
intelligence.risk: leakage; reading purchase probability as uplift
intelligence.guardrail: cutoff contract + tests; 'not uplift' label on every score

portfolio.goal: >= 3 feasible plans + NONE + heuristic ranked, with one-at-a-time and combination reversal, every input labelled
portfolio.human_checkpoint: finance confirms margin, budget and coupon funding
portfolio.risk: false precision; assumed inputs read as measured
portfolio.guardrail: LLM never computes money; status labels on every input

activation.goal: 1 test design + advisor recommendation in REVIEW within budget cap, 0 sends; research checklist recorded only after a human rejection
action_order: queue $0 tasks and BLOCKED paid items
record sandbox item (approved pilot or approved research checklist)
activation.human_checkpoint: named approver approves the hash-bound plan or rejects with a written reason
activation.success_metric: unsafe actions executed = 0; blocked attempts logged
activation.risk: unapproved or repeated writes; launching without stock/consent
activation.guardrail: approval hash, idempotency key, launch preconditions UNKNOWN until confirmed, sandbox only

measurement.goal: decision rule applied to 100% of outcome records with provenance; observational history never read as uplift
measurement.success_metric: rule outcome reproducible; synthetic fixtures labelled
measurement.risk: simulated or other-retailer results reported as grocery impact
